contentPattern: Optional heading/paragraph intro (e.g. H2 'Sign up to get the latest VA updates'), then optional two-cell config rows: Label | Email address, Button | Sign up, Action | <subscriber endpoint URL>, Name | email, Placeholder, Required | true, Success | message, Hidden | key=value. A standalone non-.json link is also accepted as the form action. Renders one required email input + submit button; without an action URL it validates and confirms locally.
